title: Margaret Cecilia Helmore
dates: (b.1849)
---

novelist, cousin of Christabel Coleridge.

The younger sister of Katherine Helmore, she was author of Luna (1873) and Cap and Bells (1875). In the 1891 census she described herself as an editor in the employment of Ward, Lock and Co..
